findings.title: Wire the new timeout setting into the shutdown drain
findings.body: A supported value such as shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 is accepted but ignored. search/scheduler.py:70–81 derives _SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_TIMEOUT solely from the environment or a hardcoded 60.0, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, shutdown therefore stops waiting after 60 seconds and closes clients and the database even when the operator configured a longer drain for an active search.
findings.recommendation: Use settings.general.shutdown_drain_timeout as the shutdown default, retaining the environment override, and add a lifecycle test proving a nondefault configuration reaches the drain timeout.

next_steps: Connect the setting to the scheduler and verify configuration and environment precedence.
